title: Voyeur
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: College student Ko Higaonna catches a man spying on him and his girlfriend Satomi with infrared goggles; after a violent encounter the goggles change hands and Ko becomes the voyeur's pupil, learning what people do in private. A one-volume seinen story by Hideo Yamamoto that touches on infidelity, jealousy and Ko's own desires.
life_message: Unclear; the story probes what hides behind people's public faces rather than holding up a model life.
